title: Revenue Partnerships
note: Owner's partnership taxonomy (September 2026). 11 families, 67 subcategories, 339 partner types.

families.name: Affiliates
families.definition: Affiliates are independent publishers, creators, list owners or businesses who promote an offer to their audience and are paid only on a tracked outcome (sale, lead, call, install or signup), attributed by link, code or platform.
families.tagline: two axes, 41 partner types, and a 60-day cookie norm

types.name: Niche blogger / SEO affiliate site
types.what: Topic site ranking for buyer-intent searches
types.bench: Content publishers earned about 16% of network affiliate revenue in 2024 ([eMarketer](https://www.emarketer.com/content/faq-on-affiliate-marketing--how-ai-creators-reshaping-channel-2026))

types.name: Review site
types.bench: Amazon category rates run 0-10% for physical goods ([Amazon Associates](https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/help/node/topic/GRXPHT8U84RAYDXZ))

types.name: Comparison / "best X" / "X vs Y" site
types.bench: B2B SaaS median 20% recurring for 12 months ([TrackRev, aggregator](https://www.trackrev.io/data/affiliate-program-benchmarks))

types.name: B2B software review / list directory
types.bench: Top 25 PartnerStack vendors paid an average 23.53% commission ([PartnerStack](https://partnerstack.com/resources/research-lab/charts/high-performing-vendors-tend-to-offer-20-25-for-commissions))

types.name: Long-form creator-affiliate
types.what: YouTube or podcast creator paid only on tracked commission
types.bench: By a brand's eighth YouTube creator partnership, CTR is 1.8x the first ([eMarketer](https://www.emarketer.com/content/faq-on-affiliate-marketing--how-ai-creators-reshaping-channel-2026))

types.name: Coupon / voucher code site
types.bench: Coupon publishers earned 42.4% of affiliate revenue in H1 2025 ([eMarketer](https://www.emarketer.com/content/faq-on-affiliate-marketing--how-ai-creators-reshaping-channel-2026))

types.name: Cashback portal
types.bench: Cashback and loyalty earned about 35% of affiliate revenue in 2024 ([eMarketer](https://www.emarketer.com/content/faq-on-affiliate-marketing--how-ai-creators-reshaping-channel-2026))

types.name: Loyalty / points / miles program
types.what: Airline, hotel or retail points malls

types.name: Affinity / closed user group
types.what: Gated audiences such as students, military, employees

types.name: Media buyer
types.what: Buys paid social, native or display to drive offers

types.name: PPC / search affiliate (incl. trademark-plus)
types.what: Bids on search terms, branded only with permission

types.name: Retargeting partner
types.bench: Display partners are often paid CPC/CPM ([impact.com](https://help.impact.com/brand/what-would-you-like-to-learn-about/partnership-strategies/working-with-partners/an-impactcom-guide-to-partner-types))

types.name: Mobile / app-install & SMS partner
types.bench: CPI and CPA are standard for mobile ([Acceleration Partners](https://www.accelerationpartners.com/resources/affiliate-partner-types/))

types.name: Pay-per-call publisher / call network
types.bench: About $15 baseline up to $400 per call at named networks ([Business of Apps](https://www.businessofapps.com/affiliate/pay-per-call/))

types.name: Owned-newsletter affiliate
types.bench: Newsletter CPA deals run $10-100 per acquisition ([beehiiv, vendor](https://www.beehiiv.com/blog/newsletter-sponsorship-cost))

types.name: Email retargeting partner
types.what: Re-mails abandoners on the brand's behalf
types.bench: Listed as an Awin partner type ([Awin](https://help.awin.com/advertisers/docs/en/partner-types-overview))

types.name: Sub-affiliate network
types.what: Houses hundreds or thousands of small publishers

types.name: Conversion-tech widget / plug-in
types.bench: Tech partners grew to about 7% of affiliate revenue, up from 5% in 2021 ([eMarketer](https://www.emarketer.com/content/faq-on-affiliate-marketing--how-ai-creators-reshaping-channel-2026))

types.name: Registry platform
types.bench: Listed as a type by Acceleration Partners ([Acceleration Partners](https://www.accelerationpartners.com/resources/affiliate-partner-types/))

types.name: Community owner affiliate
types.what: Skool, Discord, Facebook group or Reddit owner linking offers

types.name: Commission-only micro-creator
types.what: Small social creator on commission, no fee
types.bench: Creators' share of Awin revenue rose from 15.9% to 19.5% YoY ([eMarketer](https://www.emarketer.com/content/faq-on-affiliate-marketing--how-ai-creators-reshaping-channel-2026))

types.name: Agency-as-affiliate
types.what: Agency that recommends but does not resell

types.name: Customer affiliate
types.what: Customer paid cash commission for promoting to an audience
types.example: User with a tracked link on YouTube

types.name: Graduate / alumni affiliate
types.what: Course or certification graduate promoting via link

families.name: Influencers & Creators
families.definition: Influencers & Creators are individuals paid at least partly in cash, product, retainer or equity for their content, endorsement or creative voice.
families.tagline: buying a person's voice, not an ad slot

types.name: Sponsored post / video
types.what: Feed post, Reel, TikTok, Short, Story, carousel, X or FB post, Pin
types.bench: Instagram nano $20-200, micro $200-2K; rule of thumb about $100 per 10K followers ([Hootsuite](https://blog.hootsuite.com/influencer-pricing/))

types.name: Account takeover
types.what: Creator runs the brand's account for a day
types.example: Chef takes over a restaurant's Stories

types.name: Live-stream integration
types.what: Reads, overlays or sponsored streams on Twitch, YouTube Live or TikTok Live
types.pay: Per stream or per hour, priced on concurrent viewers

types.name: UGC ad creative
types.what: Testimonial, unboxing, demo and hook variants for the brand's ads
types.bench: Mid-level $150-300, median about $175 ([Influee, vendor](https://influee.co/blog/ugc-price)); UGC grew from 15% to 35% of Collabstr engagements ([Collabstr](https://collabstr.com/2026-influencer-marketing-report))

types.name: Creator content licensing
types.what: Brand licenses an existing organic post
types.example: License a viral review for ads

types.name: AI / virtual creator content
types.bench: 89% of enterprise marketers avoid virtual influencers ([IMH](https://influencermarketinghub.com/influencer-marketing-statistics/))

types.name: Meta Partnership Ads
types.what: Ads run from the creator's handle via an authorization code
types.example: Creator Reel boosted as an ad
types.bench: Fee about 25% of base rate per 30 days ([IMH](https://influencermarketinghub.com/whitelisting-and-spark-ads/)); 19% lower CPA and 13% higher CTR per Meta ([Social Media Today](https://www.socialmediatoday.com/news/meta-expands-creator-partnership-opportunities-for-brands/807691/))

types.name: TikTok Spark Ads
types.what: Boost an organic creator video with a Spark code
types.pay: Licensing fee or higher Shop commission
types.bench: About $500/month flat, or Shop commission raised 8+ points ([IMH](https://influencermarketinghub.com/whitelisting-and-spark-ads/))

types.name: YouTube creator partnerships boost
types.what: Creator video run as Shorts or in-stream ads

types.name: Dark posting
types.what: Ads from the creator's handle that never appear in the organic feed
types.bench: Covered by the [[F2.C.1 Meta Partnership Ads|F2.C.1]] fee norm

types.name: Brand ambassador
types.example: Micro creator as a yearly face

types.name: Creator advisory board / creator-in-residence
types.what: Creators who shape product and content

types.name: TikTok Shop affiliate
types.what: Creators sell via Shop, through open or targeted collabs

types.name: Livestream shopping host
types.what: Sells live on TikTok Live, Whatnot or Amazon Live
types.bench: Whatnot expected >$6B 2025 sales; livestream share of TikTok Shop fell from 26% to 18% ([eMarketer](https://www.emarketer.com/content/livestream-shopping-gains-momentum-beyond-tiktok-gen-z))

types.name: Creator name / likeness licensing
types.what: Creator IP on packaging or ads

families.name: Sponsorships
families.definition: A sponsorship is a paid placement (cash or in-kind) inside media, a property or an event that someone else owns and controls.
families.tagline: rate-card inventory in someone else's property

types.name: Newsletter primary placement
types.what: Top ad unit in an issue
types.example: Primary slot in a B2B newsletter
types.bench: CPM $10-75; B2B $50-100+ ([beehiiv, vendor](https://www.beehiiv.com/blog/newsletter-sponsorship-cost)); flat fee 2.5-5% of subscriber count ([Paved](https://www.paved.com/blog/newsletter-sponsorship-rates/))

types.name: Ad-network placement
types.pay: CPM on unique opens or CPC
types.bench: Examples: $5 CPM or $2 CPC; up to 3 ads per post ([beehiiv Help](https://www.beehiiv.com/support/article/17507491038231-ad-network-faq))

types.name: Community channel post
types.what: Sponsored post in Slack, Discord or Skool

types.name: Podcast host-read ad (mid-roll)
types.what: Host reads the sponsor spot, baked-in or recorded
types.bench: $18-30 CPM, premium up to $40-50 ([Podder](https://www.podderapp.com/post/podcast-cpm-benchmarks)); about $25 mid-roll ([Ad Results Media](https://www.adresultsmedia.com/news-insights/how-much-do-podcast-ads-cost/))

types.name: Podcast pre-roll / post-roll
types.bench: Pre-roll about $20; post-roll $1-5 (ARM 2026) vs $10-15 (ARM 2025), a conflict ([Ad Results Media](https://www.adresultsmedia.com/news-insights/how-much-do-podcast-ads-cost/))

types.name: YouTube long-form integration
types.pay: CPM on expected views or flat

types.name: Tiered package (Gold/Silver/Bronze)
types.bench: Gold $7.5-20K, Silver $3-10K, Bronze $1-5K; top tier about 3-4x bottom ([i4a](https://www.i4a.com/blog/event-sponsorship-packages/))

types.name: Session / track / keynote sponsorship
types.bench: Gold virtual tiers often include a keynote slot ([Converve](https://www.converve.com/event-networking-blog/virtual-event-sponsorship-packages-2026/))

types.name: Swag / lanyard / badge / wifi / app item
types.bench: A few hundred dollars at a 200-person regional event ([ExpoFP](https://blog.expofp.com/event-sponsorship-packages-ideas-tiers-and-pricing-examples/))

types.name: Attendee-list / lead-retrieval
types.bench: Sponsors value leads and decision-maker access over logos ([i4a](https://www.i4a.com/blog/event-sponsorship-packages/))

types.name: Webinar sponsor
types.what: Paid slot in a publisher's webinar series

types.name: Meetup / local event sponsor
types.what: Food, venue or cash for local meetups

types.name: Sponsored research / benchmark report
types.what: Sponsor funds, publisher brands the report
types.bench: Bundled into top event tiers ([Converve](https://www.converve.com/event-networking-blog/virtual-event-sponsorship-packages-2026/)); no price found

types.name: Sponsored tool / calculator / template
types.what: Branded utility in a publisher property

types.name: Sponsored series / season
types.what: Sponsor owns a season or vertical

types.name: Naming rights
types.what: Name on event, stage, award or channel

types.name: Sponsored awards / lists
types.what: Sponsor funds an award or ranking

types.name: Charity gala / golf / 5K sponsor (cause overlap)
types.what: Flat-fee visibility at a charity event

types.name: Stadium / arena signage & naming rights
types.bench: $4.5B sponsorship spend across 13 North American markets ([SponsorUnited](https://www.sponsorunited.com/insights/2025-markets-report))

families.name: Co-Promotion
families.definition: Co-Promotion is two or more businesses jointly promoting an event, offer or content piece to their combined audiences.
families.tagline: pooled audiences, shared list or shared revenue

types.name: Co-hosted webinar
types.what: Both brands on the page, both mail, leads shared
types.pay: 50/50 of net sales or 30-50% to the non-owner (inferred)
types.bench: 57% average registrant-to-attendee in B2B ([ON24](https://www.on24.com/blog/key-takeaways-from-the-2025-webinar-benchmarks-report/)). Info-product show rates are much lower

types.name: Joint workshop / masterclass
types.what: Paid or free joint training with a joint offer

types.name: Virtual summit co-host / co-producer
types.what: Co-owns the summit, list and pass revenue
types.bench: All-access pass conversion 3-5% industry-wide, about 8-13% when well run (2020 data) ([Summit in a Box](https://www.summitinabox.co/blog/virtual-summit-conversion-rates))

types.name: Summit speaker-promoter
types.what: Speaker who contractually promotes for a pass-sales share
types.bench: Speakers drove 60% of traffic in one summit that grew a list by 11,500 ([HeySummit](https://heysummit.com/blog/how-virtual-summit-grew-email-list-to-11500-without-ads))

types.name: Co-hosted challenge
types.what: Multi-day challenge run by two experts
types.bench: Warm paid challenges convert 10-15% (solo data; nothing sourced on co-hosted) ([Dream Coach Match](https://dreamcoachmatch.com/coaching-business/how-to-run-challenge-launch))

types.name: Joint in-person event / seminar / roadshow
types.what: Split venue and ad costs, shared attendee list
types.example: Two local firms co-host a seminar

types.name: Co-hosted live audio / video
types.what: X Spaces co-hosts, LinkedIn Live co-organizers, collab Lives
types.example: LinkedIn Live with a partner as co-organizer

types.name: Joint podcast crossover episode
types.what: Both shows publish the same recorded conversation
types.example: Two shows release one joint episode

types.name: Webinar swap: guest on theirs (with split)
types.what: You present to their list; they earn commission or reciprocity
types.example: Present to a partner's list and pay them 40%

types.name: Webinar swap: host them on yours
types.what: They present to your list; you earn commission

types.name: JV launch partner
types.what: List owners mail during a launch window, with leaderboards and prizes

types.name: JV launch manager / broker
types.what: Third party recruits and runs the partner team

types.name: Bundle sale
types.what: Many contributors' products sold at one price for 48 hours to 5 days

types.name: Co-sponsored giveaway / loop giveaway
types.what: Pooled prizes; entrants opt in to all partners
types.bench: Match partners of comparable size; disclose partner marketing (2016) ([Listrak](https://www.listrak.com/blog/perfect-partnerships-how-to-run-a-successful-co-branded-sweepstakes))

types.name: Seasonal joint promotion
types.what: Black Friday cross-offers, joint gift guides
types.example: Holiday gift guide of partner products

types.name: Joint packaged offer (single campaign)
types.what: Two complementary services sold together at one price for one campaign

types.name: Co-authored ebook / report / research
types.what: Joint content with shared lead capture
types.bench: Plan for roughly double a solo timeline ([HubSpot](https://blog.hubspot.com/marketing/co-marketing-guide))

types.name: Joint case study
types.what: One customer shared by two vendors

types.name: Co-authored lead magnet (split capture)
types.bench: Name the partner in the consent language ([Suzanne Dibble](https://suzannedibble.com/gdpr-data-sharing-processing-sharing-data-safely/))

types.name: Newsletter swap
types.bench: 3-5 quality partners beat many; mismatched swaps can yield zero ([Growth In Reverse](https://growthinreverse.com/cross-promotions/))

types.name: Free recommendation network
types.what: beehiiv Recommendations, Substack Recommendations, Kit Creator Network
types.bench: Kit network creators grew lists 9% more in 3 months ([Kit](https://kit.com/resources/blog/how-to-use-paid-recommendations))

types.name: Paid CPA recommendation (adjacent)
types.what: beehiiv Boosts, SparkLoop, Kit paid recommendations
types.bench: Boosts average about $1.63/sub with a 20% fee ([Newsletter Supply](https://newsletter.supply/blog/how-does-beehiiv-boosts-work)); Kit $2-20/sub ([Kit](https://kit.com/resources/blog/how-to-use-paid-recommendations))

types.name: Podcast feed swap
types.what: Each show publishes the other's full episode in its own feed
types.bench: Claimed to convert 10-40x better than standard promos ([J-Delmas, vendor](https://jdelmasstudios.com/podcast-cross-promotion-feed-swap-playbook/))

types.name: Social collab post / shoutout swap
types.what: IG Collab posts, co-authored LinkedIn posts

types.name: Post-purchase / thank-you page cross-offer
types.what: Each partner's offer on the other's confirmation page

types.name: Co-branded coupon / offer
types.what: Buy at A, get a discount at B

types.name: Jointly funded local advertising
types.what: Shared billboard, mailer or radio buy

types.name: Integration-partner joint campaign
types.what: Joint webinar, content or booth between integration partners

types.name: Account-mapping joint campaign
types.what: Campaign aimed at overlapping accounts found through Crossbeam or Reveal

types.name: Peer co-funded campaign
types.what: Two peers split the campaign budget

families.name: Stages & Media
families.definition: Stages & Media is earned or arranged exposure where you appear as a guest, speaker, expert or source on a platform someone else owns.
families.tagline: yes, a separate family, defined by who owns the platform

types.name: Interview-show guest
types.example: B2B founder on an industry podcast

types.name: Guest segment on solo / news show
types.what: Expert call-in, expert of the week

types.name: Podcast tour
types.bench: Agencies charge $500-1,500 per confirmed booking ([The Podcast Consultant](https://thepodcastconsultant.com/blog/podcast-booking-agency))

types.name: Podcast guest swap
types.what: You guest on theirs, they guest on yours

types.name: Live audio room
types.bench: LinkedIn stopped Audio Events in Dec 2024 ([Social Media Today](https://www.socialmediatoday.com/news/linkedins-phasing-dedicated-live-audio-events/733669/))

types.name: Pay-for-play sponsored guest (hybrid)
types.what: You pay the host to appear as a guest

types.name: YouTube interview guest
types.bench: 33% of weekly listeners use YouTube for podcasts ([Podnews / Edison](https://podnews.net/press-release/edison-research-infinite-dial-2025))

types.name: LinkedIn Live guest
types.what: Guest or speaker on a host's LinkedIn Live
types.bench: LinkedIn Live is now the single live entry point ([Social Media Today](https://www.socialmediatoday.com/news/linkedins-phasing-dedicated-live-audio-events/733669/))

types.name: Accelerator / incubator judge or office hours
Virtual summit speaker
types.what: Recorded or live talk with no promotion obligation
types.bench: Virtual live keynote is about 60-75% of the in-person fee ([Headliner Bureau](https://headlinerbureau.com/insights/keynote-speaker-fee-ranges))

types.name: Guest on a host's webinar
types.example: Guest trainer on a partner webinar

types.name: Bundled webinar-series presenter
types.what: One of many presenters in a series

types.name: Guest presenter at a promoter's seminar (platform selling)
types.what: Sell a program from a promoter's stage
types.bench: 50/50 promoter splits are common practice but unsourced (see Gaps)

types.name: Bootcamp / retreat guest trainer
types.what: Guest session at a bootcamp or retreat

types.name: Paid-community expert call (one-off)
types.what: One expert call in someone's paid group

types.name: Expert quote / commentary
types.what: Source in articles via query marketplaces

types.name: Newsletter guest essay
types.what: Guest issue in a host newsletter

families.name: Referral & Power Partners
families.definition: Referral & Power Partners are businesses and professionals who already serve your buyers and send you specific named introductions, or endorse your offer to their customers.

types.name: One-way paid referral (finder's fee)
types.what: Partner sends leads; you pay per lead, close or %
types.example: Realtor refers buyers to a roofer
types.pay: Flat or % of first sale / first year
types.bench: Warm intro about 10% of first-year ACV; qualified opportunity about 20% ([SaaStr](https://www.saastr.com/what-are-typical-commission-ranges-for-referral-partners-for-enterprise-b2b-saas))

types.name: Reciprocal referral
types.what: Two firms trade clients with no money
types.bench: Lawyers must keep these non-exclusive and disclosed ([Minnesota Rule 7.2](https://revisor.mn.gov/court_rules/rule/prcond-7.2/pdf))

types.name: Referral network / group
types.what: One seat per trade (BNI, leads clubs, referral circles)
types.bench: BNI reports $62,459 average closed business per US member (self-reported) ([IFA / BNI](https://www.franchise.org/2025/08/bni-mid-year-report-global-network-surges-as-businesses-prioritize-quality-referrals/))

types.name: Lead swap / lead-sharing agreement
types.example: Two gyms swap waitlists by location

types.name: Competitor overflow / pass-over
types.what: Send work you can't take to a competitor for a fee

types.name: Before (upstream) partner
types.what: Sells to the customer before they need you

types.name: During (concurrent) partner
types.what: Bought at the same time as you

types.name: Instead-of (substitute) partner
types.what: What customers buy when they don't buy you
types.example: Declined MCA applicants passed to an alternative lender

types.name: Endorsed mailing / email
types.what: Host mails their list recommending your offer under the host's name
types.pay: Commonly 50/50 of profit; Abraham cites 10-90% splits

types.name: Insert / package stuffer / invoice JV
types.what: Your offer rides in the host's shipments or invoices
types.example: Pet store bag stuffer for a groomer
types.bench: Abraham: about 5c vs 80c for a mailing, 2-3x response (anecdotal) ([Abraham PDF](https://grumomedia.com/files/Jay_Abraham-From_Mediocrity_to_Millions.pdf))

types.name: Endorsed webinar / event
types.what: Host invites their audience to your webinar
types.example: CPA firm hosts a funding-options webinar for a lending broker

types.name: Back-end JV
types.what: Partner's product offered to your buyers after purchase
types.bench: Abraham claims about 70% of profit comes from the back end ([Abraham PDF](https://grumomedia.com/files/Jay_Abraham-From_Mediocrity_to_Millions.pdf))

types.name: Front-end JV / lead-offer swap
types.what: Partner's free or low-cost offer used as your acquisition bait
types.example: Free audit from a partner as a lead magnet

types.name: Bundle / package JV
types.what: Ongoing joint offer at one price

types.name: Consignment / pay-on-sale
types.what: Product placed with a host who pays only on sale

types.name: R&D-for-share
types.what: Partner builds in exchange for a revenue share
types.example: Developer builds a tool for royalties

types.name: Dormant-list reactivation JV
types.what: Your offer to a partner's inactive customers
types.example: Mail a closed gym's old members

types.name: Idle space / equipment / inventory
types.example: Podiatrist and sleep clinic split overhead 50/50

types.name: Gap / arbitrage JV
types.what: Combine assets no one has combined

types.name: Orchestrator / JV broker
types.what: Match two parties and take an override
types.example: Agency brokers a lender + CPA deal

families.name: Access Partners
families.definition: Access Partners are organizations that own a group your buyers already belong to: members, franchisees, employees, community members or attendees.
families.tagline: paying for the room, not the sale

types.name: Trade association affinity program
types.example: State contractors' association endorses a funding broker
types.bench: Large associations earn six- and seven-figure yearly royalties ([Cavuno](https://cavuno.com/blog/non-dues-revenue))

types.name: Professional association / licensing body
types.what: CPA, bar or realtor board member benefit
types.example: CPA society endorses a tax tool
types.bench: Pure royalties are tax-exempt; services income is UBIT ([Partners in Association Management](https://yoursearchisdone.com/affinity-agreements-101/))

types.name: Credit union / community bank member offer
Franchisor preferred / approved vendor
types.what: Vendor listed or mandated for all units
types.example: Approved marketing vendor for a franchise
types.bench: Mandated tech fees run $200-2,000/month per unit; rebates rarely disclosed (advocacy source) ([Lopes Law](https://lopeslawllc.com/franchise-preferred-vendor-program-costs/))

types.name: GPO / buying group
types.bench: Safe harbor at 3% or less; largest GPOs averaged 1.22-2.25% (2008 data) ([GAO](https://www.gao.gov/assets/a308834.html))

types.name: Dealer council
types.what: Vendor to a dealer network's council

types.name: Paid community member perk
types.what: Offer in a Skool, Circle or Mighty "perks" tab

types.name: Meetup / networking host
types.what: Host introduces you to the group on a standing basis

types.name: Webinar-series host
types.what: Standing offer across a host's series

types.name: Coach / consultant client book
types.what: Introduces you to their whole client roster
types.example: Coach offers your service to 40 clients

types.name: Business broker
types.what: Access to buyers and sellers they represent

types.name: Fractional executive portfolio
types.what: Fractional CFO or CMO across clients

types.name: Accountant / attorney advisory base
types.pay: Flat or services fee (check professional rules)

families.name: Channel Partners
families.definition: Channel Partners are third parties who resell, deliver, embed or distribute your offer.
families.tagline: they sell, deliver, bill or embed your offer

types.name: TSD / master agent + technology advisor
types.bench: $16.6B TSD billings in 2024; 86% of partners are advisors ([Omdia](https://omdia.tech.informa.com/blogs/2026/jan/key-insights-from-the-16point6bn-dollars-technology-services-distribution-tsd-market))

types.name: Funding / loan broker ISO
types.example: Sub-broker network for a funding brokerage

types.name: Implementation / solutions partner
types.pay: Rev share on sourced MRR + services
types.bench: Upmarket referral pays 20% for one year on $3K+ MRR ([HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/solutions-partners-tiers-and-benefits-2026))

types.name: Implementation agency partner
types.what: Agency that deploys your product for its clients

types.name: OEM / embedded
types.what: Your product inside theirs under their SKU
types.example: Scheduling engine inside a vertical CRM
types.bench: Salesforce OEM apps pay 25% of net revenue ([Appnigma](https://appnigma.ai/blogs/salesforce-appexchange-revenue-share/))

types.name: Platform-built app
types.what: App built on a host platform

types.name: Hyperscaler marketplace (incl. CPPO)
types.what: AWS, Azure or GCP listing; resellers transact via private offers

types.name: SaaS app marketplace
types.what: HubSpot, AppExchange, GHL, Shopify, Zapier, Atlassian

types.name: White-label SaaS reseller
types.what: Partner resells your software under their brand
types.bench: GHL SaaS mode needs the $497/month plan; usage often rebilled at 2-4x ([CoursePlatformsReview](https://www.courseplatformsreview.com/blog/highlevel-saas-mode/))

types.name: White-label fulfilment reseller
types.what: Partner resells your service under their brand
types.example: Agency resells white-label SEO or VA services

types.name: Private-label course / certification reseller
types.what: Partner resells your finished course as theirs
types.example: Coach resells a private-label AI course

families.name: Strategic Alliances & Licensing
families.definition: Strategic Alliances & Licensing are long-term contractual or equity arrangements that share intellectual property, brand, method, territory, ownership or operations, beyond any single campaign or sale.

types.name: Co-branded offer
types.what: Two brands on one ongoing product

types.name: Ingredient branding
types.what: Partner's brand as a named component

types.name: Co-developed product
types.what: Jointly built product with shared IP
types.example: Two agencies build an AI audit tool

types.name: Private-label product sourcing
types.what: Made to your spec, sold only under your brand

types.name: Brand / trademark licensing
types.what: Licensee uses your name on their products
types.example: Gym brand on a supplement line
types.bench: Service royalties 2-15%; adjusted royalties up to 12-14% ([Flowhaven](https://www.flowhaven.com/resources/major-types-of-royalty-rates-in-brand-licensing))

types.name: Content / curriculum / IP licensing
types.what: License a course, framework or certification
types.example: AI curriculum licensed to a college

types.name: Franchise (FTC-regulated)
types.what: Trademark + significant control + required payment of $735+
types.bench: Average 6.7% of gross; business services about 11.9% ([Franzy](https://franzy.com/blog/average-franchise-royalty-fee/))

types.name: Licensed operator / certification program
types.what: Use of a method or name without significant control
types.example: Certified AI integrator operating under your method

types.name: Area developer / master franchise
types.what: Develops multiple units in a region

types.name: Equity joint venture
types.example: Coach + AI builder form a NewCo

types.name: Minority-stake alliance
types.what: One partner takes a stake in the other

types.name: Earn-in deal
types.what: Partner earns equity by hitting milestones
types.example: Operator earns a stake for building sales

types.name: Purchasing co-op / GPO formation
types.bench: Healthcare safe harbor at 3% or less ([CASRAI](https://casrai.org/guides/gpo-safe-harbor))

types.name: Community group-buying deal
types.what: Negotiated volume discount for a community
types.example: Software discount for a Skool group

types.name: Shared staff / office / back office
types.example: Shared SDR team or call center

types.name: Teaming agreement / joint bid
types.example: Two firms team on an RFP

types.name: Exclusive distribution rights
types.what: Secure exclusive rights to distribute a product

families.name: Cause & Nonprofit Partners
families.definition: Cause & Nonprofit Partners are charities, schools, teams, faith and civic groups where the business's contribution (a percentage of sales, a donation per unit, a fundraiser share or in-kind support) produces revenue, traffic or community access in return.
families.tagline: giving tied to sales or traffic

types.name: Percent-of-sale / $-per-unit
types.what: Fixed share of each purchase donated during a campaign
types.example: $25 per HVAC tune-up to a food bank
types.bench: Disclose amount, dates and cap ([Engage for Good](https://engageforgood.com/resource/do-good-and-sell-it-well-an-overview-of-cause-marketing-regulation/))

types.name: Buy-one-give-one / in-kind
types.what: Product or service donated per sale

types.name: Checkout / round-up ask
types.bench: $275M raised across 92 campaigns in 2024; average gift $1.13 ([NonProfit Times](https://thenonprofittimes.com/npt_articles/checkout-campaigns-rang-up-275-million-in-2024/))

types.name: Cause affiliate
types.what: Nonprofit promotes via a tracked link and earns a donation per sale
types.example: Charity link on a brand's network

types.name: Spirit / fundraiser night
types.what: Group brings its people; business donates a share of the night's sales
types.example: Restaurant spirit night for a PTA

types.name: Product fundraiser / gift-card resale
types.what: Group sells your product or cards at a margin

types.name: Fundraiser service partnership
types.what: You run the fundraiser with the nonprofit

types.name: Charity auction / in-kind event donor
types.what: Donate a package to a gala or auction
types.example: Spa package at a school auction

types.name: Percent-of-revenue pledge
types.what: Ongoing pledge such as 1% for the Planet or Pledge 1%
types.example: Coffee roaster joins 1% for the Planet

types.name: B Corp / benefit corporation
types.example: Agency certifies as a B Corp
types.pay: Certification cost; B Corp buyer networks

types.name: Faith / civic community partnership
types.what: Member discount through churches or civic groups

types.name: Nonprofit referral program
types.what: Nonprofit refers members; business donates per job

types.name: Employee volunteering / gift matching
types.what: Company matches staff gifts or time

families.name: House Partners
families.definition: House Partners are the business's own base: customers, past buyers, old leads, employees, contractors and alumni.
families.tagline: your own customers, leads, staff and alumni

types.name: Refer-a-friend (give/get)
types.bench: Share rate 15% solid, 30% excellent; referral 5-15% of revenue healthy (2022) ([Friendbuy](https://www.friendbuy.com/blog/referral-rates))

types.name: B2B customer referral program
types.what: Account credits, cash or charity donation for referrals
types.bench: 84% of B2B buyers start with a referral (secondary) ([Shno](https://www.shno.co/marketing-statistics/customer-advocacy-statistics))

types.name: Reference customer
types.example: Reference call for an enterprise deal
types.bench: 21% say finding references is the main SaaS buying roadblock ([Shno](https://www.shno.co/marketing-statistics/customer-advocacy-statistics))

types.name: Review generator
types.bench: 70% of B2B buyers rely on peer reviews ([Shno](https://www.shno.co/marketing-statistics/customer-advocacy-statistics))

types.name: User-group champion / community MVP
types.what: Runs user groups or leads the community

types.name: Customer speaker
types.what: Customer on your stage or webinar

types.name: Upsell / cross-sell / ascension ladder
types.what: Move buyers up the offer ladder

types.name: Multi-location / account expansion
types.what: Expand into new sites or departments

types.name: Customer-to-partner conversion
types.what: Customer becomes affiliate, reseller or implementer
types.pay: Hand-off to [[F1 Affiliates|F1]], [[F8 Channel Partners|F8]] or [[F9 Strategic Alliances & Licensing|F9]]

types.name: Dormant-lead database reactivation
types.what: SMS, email or AI calling to old leads
types.bench: Reactivation of inactive customers averages 12-20% ([Eightx](https://eightx.co/blog/average-win-back-reactivation-rate-benchmarks)); no B2B lead data

types.name: Lapsed-subscription win-back
types.bench: About 1 in 4 new subscriptions come from previously cancelled subscribers ([Recurly](https://recurly.com/blog/customer-winback-strategies-for-subscriptions/))

types.name: Pause-instead-of-cancel
types.bench: 75% of paused customers return to billing ([Recurly](https://recurly.com/blog/customer-winback-strategies-for-subscriptions/))

types.name: Employee hiring referral
types.bench: 28.2% of referred applicants hired; construction bonus about $2,500 ([Hellora](https://www.hellora.com/resources/the-state-of-employee-referral-programs-key-insights-benchmarks))

types.name: Employee advocacy
types.bench: Employee-shared content gets about 8x engagement (older data) ([Oktopost](https://www.oktopost.com/blog/employee-advocacy-statistics-2026/))

types.name: Boomerang alumni network
types.what: Former staff as referrers and rehires

types.name: Placed contractors / VAs
types.what: VAs placed with clients refer new clients
